articles.title: Automattic begins layoffs following board upheaval and executive departures
articles.summary: Automattic has begun laying off employees across multiple teams, including WordPress.com and its enterprise business, following a board shakeup and a series of executive departures. Sources say more cuts could follow as the company looks to improve its finances.

articles.title: GM is betting compute and AI will help it compete with Chinese automakers
articles.summary: To compete with Tesla, Rivian, and a host of Chinese automakers, GM’s fourth-gen EV platform will roll out a new central computer and electrical architecture that will debut in 2028 in the Cadillac Escalade IQ.

articles.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal
articles.summary: The payout is related to a recent trial involving the social media giant that revolved around its data privacy practices.

articles.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
articles.summary: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

articles.title: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day
articles.summary: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.

articles.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
articles.summary: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

articles.title: GM is giving OnStar an AI makeover
articles.summary: It's one of the biggest overhauls ever to the 30-year-old connected car product.

articles.title: PHP armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
articles.summary: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.

articles.title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
articles.summary: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

articles.title: Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport
articles.summary: Pickups and dropoffs will happen at dedicated "autonomous vehicle zones" at Terminal 1 and Terminal 3.

articles.title: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
articles.summary: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.

articles.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
articles.summary: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

articles.title: Heat pump tech is 170 years old — Pascal thinks it’s time for an update
articles.summary: Refrigerants startup Pascal has a new take on heat pump and cooling tech using a sponge-like material that promises to be 20% more efficient.

articles.title: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software
articles.summary: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.

articles.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
articles.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

articles.title: SpaceX and Tesla boards form special committees to review merger
articles.summary: Elon Musk likes the idea but says he is not on either committee, which is made up of independent directors.

articles.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
articles.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

articles.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
articles.summary: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

articles.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
articles.summary: SpaceX hit profitability in the third quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
articles.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

articles.summary: We all know exercise is good for us. It builds muscle, strengthens bones, lowers blood pressure, and boosts mood.
